name: Crippling
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 3rd; Craft Magic Arms and Armor; chill touch; Price +1 bonus.

DESCRIPTION

When this weapon inflicts damage with a sneak attack or in conjunction with a successful critical hit it also inflicts 1 point of Strength damage.
